ai_summary: Cupid Limited is converting up to 30,00,000 warrants into equity shares of Baazar Style Retail Limited, a growing specialty retail chain, incurring a cash outlay of approximately Rs. 73.86 Crores. This strategic investment aims to leverage Baazar Style's extensive retail network to significantly expand distribution and consumer reach for Cupid's FMCG product portfolio. However, this represents a substantial capital allocation and a notable diversification into a largely unrelated industry (fashion retail for a condom/IVD manufacturer), which could present unique integration and execution risks.
